titleZh: 这是一台小猜词机
titleEn: This is a small next-word machine
bodyZh: 你现在在文字课的第一关。这是一台小猜词机：左边是已经有的词，中间正在计算，右边是它要猜的下一个词。先点上方任务区的「生成下一个词」，看它抽出一个词接在后面。现在还不用管公式，也不用拧温度。
bodyEn: You are on the first station of the text course. This is a small next-word machine: the left side holds the words so far, the middle is computing, and the right side is the next word it is about to guess. Click “Generate next token” in the task cluster under the top bar and watch it append one word. No formulas yet, and leave later knobs alone.
nextStepHintZh: 现在先点「生成下一个词」，看见它抽出一个词后，再点「推进一步」。
nextStepHintEn: Click Generate first. After you see a word appear, press 推进一步 (step forward).

titleZh: 右边表是下一个词的候选和百分比
titleEn: The right-hand table is the next-word candidates and their percentages
bodyZh: 右边那张表是「下一个词」的候选名单。每一行是一个词，后面的百分比是它被抽中的机会。{topList}就是眼下最靠前的几行。百分比是从分数来的，但这一关先把表看清楚；等走过「生成下一个词」后，推演卡会用表上的数一步步算给你看。
bodyEn: The table on the right is the shortlist for the next word. Each row is a candidate, and the percentage is its chance of being drawn. Right now the top rows are: {topList}. Those percentages come from scores, but first just read the table. After you generate a word, the walk-through card will use these exact numbers.
nextStepHintZh: 先看清右表。若还没生成，就点「生成下一个词」；若已经看到词，可再点「推进一步」。
nextStepHintEn: Read the right-hand table. If you have not generated yet, click Generate; otherwise you can press 推进一步.

titleZh: 温度现在还不用拧
titleEn: Leave temperature alone for now
bodyZh: 温度、Top-k、Top-p 只改「怎么从右边的概率表里抽一个词」，不改模型本身。它们现在还锁着。先看它怎么抽出一个词；走到「现在才拧抽词旋钮」那一关，再动手。
bodyEn: Temperature, top-k and top-p only change how a word is drawn from the right-hand table. They do not change the model itself. Those knobs are still locked. First watch how it draws a word; they unlock at the station called “now you may turn the sampling knobs.”
nextStepHintZh: 先回到当前这一步，把「生成下一个词」看完，再跟着「推进一步」走到旋钮那一关。
nextStepHintEn: Stay on this step, finish watching Generate, then use 推进一步 until the knobs unlock.

titleZh: 模型读的是词片，不是整句
titleEn: The model reads token pieces, not the whole sentence
bodyZh: 模型读的不是整句汉字，而是一小片一小片。换上「残差连接把前面的信号加到后面。」之后，左边会写成「残·1/3」这样，方便你看见切法。中文一个字常被切成多片，不是界面坏了。
bodyEn: The model does not read a whole Chinese sentence at once; it reads small pieces. After you switch to the shared sentence, the left side labels pieces like “残·1/3” so you can see the cuts. One Chinese character often becomes several pieces — that is not a bug.
nextStepHintZh: 看清左边的词片后，再点「推进一步」，去看中间的亮线。
nextStepHintEn: Once you can see the pieces on the left, press 推进一步 to look at the lit lines in the middle.

titleZh: 中间的亮线是「现在在看谁」
titleEn: The lit lines are who it is looking at now
bodyZh: 写到某一个词时，模型会回头多看上文的某几片。中间那些亮起来的线，就是「现在在看谁」。点左边一个词片，看连线有没有亮起来。{token}这一片是眼下的着眼点；第 {layer} 层、第 {head} 个头是你现在翻到的那一组。
bodyEn: When writing a word, the model looks back at some earlier pieces. The lit lines in the middle are who it is looking at. Click a piece on the left and watch the lines light up. The current focus is {token}; you are on layer {layer}, head {head}.
nextStepHintZh: 看过亮线后，点「推进一步」去翻一层、换一个头。
nextStepHintEn: After you have seen a lit line, press 推进一步 to change layer and head.

titleZh: 同一件事会做很多层、好几组一起看
titleEn: The same look-back happens across layers and heads
bodyZh: 不是只算一次。模型把「看上文、再加工」重复很多层；每一层里还有好几组一起看。点中间「Transformer Block」旁边的箭头换一层，再点注意力标题旁的箭头换一个头。你现在在第 {layer} 层、第 {head} 个头。
bodyEn: It is not computed only once. The model repeats “look back, then process” across many layers, and each layer has several heads looking together. Use the arrows beside Transformer Block to change layer, and the arrows beside the attention title to change head. You are on layer {layer}, head {head}.
nextStepHintZh: 翻过层和头之后，点「推进一步」，去对残差那条旁路。
nextStepHintEn: After you have changed layer and head, press 推进一步 to match the residual bypass.

titleZh: 残差就是把前面的信号加到后面
titleEn: Residual means adding the earlier signal back at the end
bodyZh: 有一条旁路，会把前面的信号直接加到后面，免得走得太深时把有用的信息冲掉。这就是那句贯穿例句「残差连接把前面的信号加到后面。」在讲的事。在图上找到标着残差的加号或旁路线，把它和这句话对上。
bodyEn: A bypass adds the earlier signal back at the end, so useful information is not washed out as the stack goes deeper. That is exactly what the shared sentence “Residual connections add the earlier signal to what comes later.” is talking about. Find the residual plus sign or bypass on the diagram and match it to that sentence.
nextStepHintZh: 对上残差后，再点「推进一步」，才会出现抽词旋钮。
nextStepHintEn: After you have matched the residual, press 推进一步 — that is when the sampling knobs appear.

titleZh: 旋钮只改怎么从表里抽，不改模型
titleEn: The knobs only change the draw, not the model
bodyZh: 抽词旋钮现在解开了。温度、Top-k、Top-p 只改「怎么从右边的概率表里抽一个词」，不改模型本身。拖一下温度，只看右边概率条是变尖还是变平。{topList}会跟着变。
bodyEn: The sampling knobs are unlocked now. Temperature, top-k and top-p only change how a word is drawn from the right-hand table, not the model itself. Drag temperature and watch whether the bars on the right get sharper or flatter. The top rows {topList} will move with it.
nextStepHintZh: 试过旋钮后，点「推进一步」，会告诉你教材在书库里，不会自动打开。
nextStepHintEn: After you try the knobs, press 推进一步. It will tell you the textbook lives in the Library — it does not auto-open.

titleZh: 拧温度不是在训练
titleEn: Turning temperature is not training
bodyZh: 这是一个常见误会：拧温度并不是在训练，也不会改权重。温度只改从右边表里怎么抽一个词。只有微调课里真正开训，才会改权重。
bodyEn: A common mix-up: turning temperature is not training, and it does not change weights. Temperature only changes how a token is drawn from the right-hand table. Weights change only when you actually start a run in the fine-tune course.
nextStepHintZh: 分清「抽样」和「训练」后，再回到当前这一关继续走。
nextStepHintEn: Once sampling and training are distinct, return to the current station and continue.

titleZh: 先走短路，教材不必先打开
titleEn: Follow the short path; the textbook does not have to open first
bodyZh: 完整教材在顶栏「书库」里，给想再往下走的人准备，不会自动打开。现在先跟着当前这一关和「推进一步」走，看见画面上的现象就够了。
bodyEn: The full textbook lives in the Library for later. It does not auto-open. For now, follow this station and 推进一步, and watch what appears on the screen.
nextStepHintZh: 继续走当前这一关即可，不必先翻开教材。
nextStepHintEn: Stay on the current station. You do not need to open the textbook first.

titleZh: 这一课改的是权重，不是温度
titleEn: This course changes weights, not temperature
bodyZh: 你现在在微调课的第一关。文字课只改抽样（温度），这一课才改权重。这是本机 GPT-2 小实验，不是在调 ChatGPT。主按钮「推进一步」只讲解，不开训。先看工作室里那句示例会被切成哪些词片。
bodyEn: You are at the first station of the fine-tune course. The text course only changed sampling (temperature). This course changes weights. It is a local GPT-2 experiment, not a way to tune ChatGPT. The main button 推进一步 only explains; it does not start training. First look at how the example sentence is cut into pieces.
nextStepHintZh: 先分清抽样和训练，再点「推进一步」去看分词。
nextStepHintEn: Once sampling and training are distinct, press 推进一步 to preview tokens.

titleZh: 训练吃进去的是词片
titleEn: Training eats token pieces
bodyZh: 训练真正吃进去的是词片，不是整句汉字。中文一个字常被切成多片，不是界面故障。到数据台看完整分词，认一认那些小标签。预览不会开训。
bodyEn: Training actually eats token pieces, not whole Chinese sentences. One character may become several pieces — that is not a UI bug. Open the data bench, preview tokenization, and read the chips. Previewing does not start a run.
nextStepHintZh: 看过词片后，再往前走到「存下微调前的续写」。
nextStepHintEn: After you have seen the chips, move on to saving a baseline continuation.

titleZh: 开训前先存一份真正的基线续写
titleEn: Save a real baseline continuation before you train
bodyZh: 没有「前」，开训后就没法对照。必须让本机教学服务真正写出续写，才算存好。没连上时不能把这一步标成已完成。
bodyEn: Without a “before”, you cannot compare after training. The local teaching service must actually write a continuation. This step cannot be marked done while the trainer is off.
nextStepHintZh: 存好基线后，再去做一次极短跑。
nextStepHintEn: After the baseline is saved, do one very short run.

titleZh: 开训才会改权重
titleEn: Weights change only when a run actually starts
bodyZh: 开训才会改权重。先跑通一次极短跑即可，不必一开始就训很久。只看着按钮，还不能算做过。损失越低不一定越好。
bodyEn: Weights change only when a run actually starts. A very short run is enough to see the loop work; you do not need a long train first. Looking at the button is not enough. Lower loss is not always better.
nextStepHintZh: 跑通之后，用同一批提示词看前后差别，然后再看「损失是什么」。
nextStepHintEn: After a short run, compare the same prompts, then look at “what loss is.”

titleZh: 损失只说明数字在动，对照才看话有没有跟着走
titleEn: Loss says the number moved; the comparison shows whether the text followed
bodyZh: 损失只说明数字在动。要看续写有没有跟着语料走，要用同一批提示词看前后对照。拧温度只改抽样，不是又训练一次。
bodyEn: Loss only tells you the number is moving. To see whether the continuation followed your texts, compare the same prompts before and after. Turning temperature only changes sampling — it is not another training run.
nextStepHintZh: 看过对照后，点「下一步：看看损失是什么」。
nextStepHintEn: After the comparison, go on to “what loss is.”

titleZh: 损失就是「下一个词猜对了没有」的一张表
titleEn: Loss is a table of whether the next token was guessed right
bodyZh: 损失不是玄学。把这句话里的每一个「下一个词」看成一格：猜对了就记得很有把握，猜错了就记得很意外。把这些意外加起来，就是损失。若画面上有 1/25 或 3.22 这样的数，就指着那张示意表看，不必先背交叉熵三个字。
bodyEn: Loss is not a mystery. Treat each next token as a cell: a correct guess is recorded as confident, a wrong guess as surprising. Add those surprises, and that is the loss. If you can see numbers such as 1/25 or 3.22, point at that schematic — you do not have to memorize the name cross-entropy first.
nextStepHintZh: 看清损失示意后，可以再看「改的是哪一块」，不必一上来就上工业级平台。
nextStepHintEn: After you can read the loss schematic, you can see which piece is being changed. This is not an industrial training platform.

titleZh: 损失越低不一定越好
titleEn: Lower loss is not always better
bodyZh: 损失越低不一定越好，多训几轮也不一定更好。会背笔记原句，也不等于真的懂了那种口吻。先看对照续写有没有跟着走，再决定要不要继续训。
bodyEn: Lower loss is not always better, and more steps are not always better. Reciting a note verbatim is not the same as learning the voice. Look at the before/after continuations first, then decide whether to keep training.
nextStepHintZh: 回到对照和损失示意，先会读数，再谈要不要多训。
nextStepHintEn: Return to the comparison and the loss schematic; learn to read the number before training longer.

titleZh: 图片课先看见一张图是怎么被一步步洗干净的
titleEn: The image course starts by watching a picture get cleaned step by step
bodyZh: 你现在在图片课的第一关。左边是条件，中间是正在去噪的画面，右边可以对照。先按教练条走，看清画布，再点「再去噪一步」。现在还不用拧高阶旋钮。
bodyEn: You are at the first station of the image course. The condition is on one side, the canvas in the middle is being denoised, and a comparison can appear on the other side. Follow the coach, look at the canvas, then click “denoise one step.” Leave the advanced knobs for later.
nextStepHintZh: 看清画布后，点「再去噪一步」，再问「这一步在算什么」。
nextStepHintEn: After you can see the canvas, click “denoise one step”, then ask what that step is computing.

titleZh: 「再去噪一步」就是把画面里的噪声再抹掉一点
titleEn: “Denoise one step” wipes a little more noise off the canvas
bodyZh: 「再去噪一步」在算的是：根据当前这张还比较吵的图，估计噪声在哪里，再把那一部分减掉一点。多点几次，画面会一点点清楚。先看画布上的变化；算式在你至少点过一次之后，才会在推演卡里用这一步的数展开。
bodyEn: “Denoise one step” estimates where the noise is in the current noisy picture, then subtracts a bit of it. Click again and the picture gets clearer. Watch the canvas first; the walk-through uses this step’s numbers only after you have denoised at least once.
nextStepHintZh: 至少点一次「再去噪一步」，再看推演卡或继续「推进一步」。
nextStepHintEn: Click “denoise one step” at least once, then open the walk-through or press 推进一步.

titleZh: 两张对照图是有条件和没有条件各走一步再合成
titleEn: The two comparison pictures are a conditioned step and an unconditioned step, then combined
bodyZh: 对照层里的两张图，是「听这句话」和「不听这句话」各走一步，再按引导程度合成。先看清两张图的差别，再谈公式名字。
bodyEn: The two comparison pictures are one step that follows the prompt and one step that does not, then combined by the guidance strength. See the difference first, and name the formula later.
nextStepHintZh: 看清对照后，再决定要不要拧引导程度。
nextStepHintEn: Once you can see the comparison, you may try the guidance strength.

titleZh: 这是一台小旋律机，一次猜下一个音
titleEn: This is a small melody machine that guesses the next note
bodyZh: 你现在在音乐课的第一关。左边是已经有的音，中间是琴卷，右边是下一个音的概率。先看清这三块，再让它写出下一个音。现在还不用拧旋钮。
bodyEn: You are at the first station of the music course. Left: the notes so far. Middle: the piano roll. Right: the next-note probabilities. Map those three parts first, then let it write the next note. Leave the knobs for later.
nextStepHintZh: 看清三块之后，让它写出下一个音，再问右边的概率。
nextStepHintEn: After you can map the three parts, let it write the next note, then ask about the probabilities on the right.

titleZh: 右边是下一个音的候选，和文字课是同一件事
titleEn: The right side is the next-note shortlist — the same idea as the text course
bodyZh: 右边那些百分比，是「下一个音」的候选，和文字课右边「下一个词」的表是同一件事。{topList}是眼下最靠前的几个音。先看表，再听它写出的音；推演卡会用表上的数一步步算。
bodyEn: The percentages on the right are candidates for the next note — the same idea as the next-word table in the text course. The top rows right now are {topList}. Read the table, then listen to the note it writes; the walk-through will use these numbers.
nextStepHintZh: 看过下一个音的表，可以再点「推进一步」，或听一听写出的旋律。
nextStepHintEn: After you have read the next-note table, press 推进一步 or listen to the melody it writes.
